subject.title: Skill Workshop: scan older sessions for skill ideas

question: Should Skill Workshop add a manual progressive scan of older foreground sessions, and what exact consent, eligibility, cursor-reset, and cost-disclosure contract should govern it?
rationale: Current behavior defines only active-conversation and current-turn capture; historical transcript access and persistent coverage introduce new privacy, provider-cost, data-lifecycle, and UX policy that cannot be inferred safely from the implementation.

options.title: Approve bounded manual scanning
options.body: Define explicit operator consent, foreground-session filters, fixed batch and proposal limits, SQLite cursor semantics, reset behavior, cost copy, and pending-only output before implementation.

options.title: Limit scans to selected sessions
options.body: Add a session picker or named-session source flow without automatic backward traversal or persistent coverage.

options.title: Retain current learning flow
options.body: Continue using current-conversation `/learn` and current-turn suggestions or autonomous capture only.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded manual scanning
recommendation.body: Define explicit operator consent, foreground-session filters, fixed batch and proposal limits, SQLite cursor semantics, reset behavior, cost copy, and pending-only output before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the feature, own this assigned proposal, and are the strongest available owner for its product and privacy contract.
